remarks: One bedroom deluxe layout style F gives you the option to use half of the unit and rent the other side. Fractional Ownership gives you 10-11 weeks at the Tamarack Club or about 1 week per month on a rotating basis. Ownership amenities include underground parking while lodging overnight, access to complimentary valet services, year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, hot tubs, fitness center, sauna, private owner's lounge and private locker rooms. Renovations will begin on this floor in the spring or fall of 2026!
